rag.text:
Test: TC-5156 — SPM - Workday - Synchronizing single Resource
Priority: Medium | Status: In Review | Type: Manual
Folder: /BP/SPM/TS-505 Workday
Labels: spm-paulina-tc, teamace, teamresources

Description:
In order to execute this test, first execute Workday Integration [https://appfire.atlassian.net/browse/TC-5064|https://appfire.atlassian.net/browse/TC-5064|smart-link]

Steps:
1. Navigate to Administration → Resources → Individuals
   Expected: Individuals list is displayed

Following buttons are displayed at the top-right:

* Refresh Workday absences
* Synchronize with Tempo
* Assign To
* Add new Individual
2. Click on three dots on Full Name column, type userName1 and select
   Data: userName: paulina.sendecka 

(or any user that is conducting test case)
   Expected: User Paulina Sendecka is selected
3. In Workday, Add absence1 and absence2 for your userName
   Data: userName: paulina.sendecka

(or any user that is conducting test case)

absence1: Today’s date

absence2: Tomorrow’s date
   Expected: Absence is added
4. Ask you manager to approve absence1

(remember to remove it after tests)
   Expected: 
5. Navigate to Administration → Resources → Individuals
   Expected: Individuals list is displayed

Following buttons are displayed at the top-right:

* Refresh Workday absences
* Synchronize with Tempo
* Assign To
* Add new Individual
6. Click on three dots on Full Name column, type userName1 and select
   Data: userName: paulina.sendecka 

(or any user that is conducting test case)
   Expected: User Paulina Sendecka is selected
7. Click on userName
   Data: userName: paulina.sendecka

(or any user that is conducting test case)
   Expected: User Details page is displayed

'Refresh Workday absences' button is displayed
8. Click on 'Refresh Workday absences' button
   Expected: Refresh Workday absences button is gray and has a loading icon

In the left corner there’s blue message

'Synchronization with Workday in progress

The synchronization of absences from Workday is currently in progress. We will notify you once it has been completed'

After few seconds, green message is displayed ‘Synchronization with Workday finished’

Absence1 is displayed in user details under Absences tab

Absence2 is not displayed as it wasn’t approved
